answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent is a vertex that earns only after three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks 10 POA it pays itself. If the newcomer is later slashed as a sybil, every voucher loses that bond, so each fake identity costs the ring fresh stake from real, distinct peers. Survives a collusive cluster: vouches from wallets funded by one source count once, so a ring cannot summit the threshold alone. Saffron-rare trust stays expensive.
